question: Which of the following actors has been appointed as the brand ambassador of RBI's public awareness campaign?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitabh Bachchan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitabh Bachchan **has been **appointed as the brand ambassador of RBI's public awareness campaign**
 
• **RBI also launched a safety campaign advising p**eople to remain healthy 
 
• It is safe by not going to bank branches as the whole country was put under lockdown to help contain the spread of coronavirus infections. 
 
• Amitabh Bachchan promoted **digital banking during the lockdown period urging people to adopt digital payment and be safe**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The RBI keeps on informing about dos and don'ts that have to be followed by customers to transact safely and securely as part of the public awareness initiative.
 
• The RBI has been running the campaign for more than a year not only in English and Hindi but in various regional languages for maximum reach.
 
• **The RBI has beaten US Federal Reserve and European Central Bank on Twitter by emerging as the most popular central bank on the microblogging site**, although with less monetary firepower.
 
• RBI's Twitter handle has 9.66 lakh followers while the world's most powerful central bank US Federal Reserve has only about 6.64 lakh followers and the Frankfurt-headquartered European Central Bank, the second most powerful monetary authority in the world, has 5.81 lakh followers.
